summary: Extensions make dispatch risk-aware and keep the review queue within human capacity.

items.text: Attach a risk class and review contract at dispatch: required tests, prohibited paths, evidence to capture, maximum cost, and the person or role authorized to accept.
Use bounded concurrency and review-queue backpressure so new work is not fired when completed artifacts already exceed reviewer capacity.
Route tasks using measured capability by task type, then feed accepted, revised, rejected, and regressed outcomes back into that map.
Require plan approval before firing work whose direction is expensive to reverse, while allowing direct execution for narrow, well-tested changes.
